people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus said to him, “Don’t forbid him, for he who is not against us is for us.”
translations.bsb: “Do not stop him,” Jesus replied, “for whoever is not against you is for you.”
translations.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Forbid him not: for he that is not against us is for us.
